title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Sorting Frame. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. (The layout is a separate, later round.)

options.label: Sorting Frame
options.lineage: post-room pigeonhole frames and brass label holders
options.thesis: Every session is a slot; one that needs you pushes a vermilion tab out past the edge.
options.viewport: Green frame header, shelves of session slots with brass designators, tabs on the right edge.
options.risk: Can read as a skin if the tab isn't used everywhere.

raised.raise: Colour quarantine: vermilion exists only on needs-you tabs and answer cards.
Structure is hairlines and one shadow, never nested cards.
Duration is length: a working slot draws a rule as long as its time in state.
Stable designators (PAN·1) identical on every surface a session appears.
Unknown or stale state is hatched, never drawn as solid fact.

options.label: Flight Strip Board
options.lineage: air-traffic flight progress strips in a strip bay
options.thesis: Each agent is a coloured paper strip; a strip that needs you is cocked out of line.
options.viewport: Dark bay header, strips stacked by state, needs-you strips offset to the right with a pencil mark.
options.risk: Closest to my own instinct for 'queue of things in flight'; familiar to ATC fans, opaque to nobody.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: airport gate boards and segmented boarding passes
options.thesis: Sessions rerank in place like departures; a changed one stays lit until you've seen it.
options.viewport: Board of rows ordered by urgency, the session view as a segmented pass.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and is very clear; loses narrowly on identity: it reads as travel, not your desk.
options.risk: Amber-on-black boards drift toward a generic 'ops dashboard' look.

options.label: Lexicon Plate
options.thesis: Black text columns; colour only inside bordered plates.
options.viewport: Guide words naming the sessions in view.
options.risk: A reading world on a glance-and-tap screen.
options.case: Loses both axes on a one-hand operate screen.

options.label: Annual Plate Section
options.case: Fuses poorly: nothing to show off here.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: Shape is direction, length is duration.
options.viewport: A vertical staff of agent activity.

options.label: Event Circle Catalog
options.thesis: Stamp-sized cells keyed to table codes.
options.viewport: A dense grid of session cells.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Translucent sheets and hatch density as load.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean iOS-style list app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Large-title Sessions list, grouped by project, status badges, tab bar.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any client app by design.
